meta.description: Boutique hotel in Lara, Antalya with views of the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains. Bed & breakfast, outdoor pool, spa and Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen.

hero.title: A boutique stay facing the Mediterranean
hero.text: In Şirinyalı, with views of the sea and the Taurus Mountains — comfort with a personal touch.

intro.title: By the sea, in the heart of the city
intro.text: Our hotel in Şirinyalı pairs views of the Mediterranean and the Taurus Mountains with the warmth of a boutique hotel. Start the day with breakfast overlooking the sea at Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen, just across the street.

rooms.title: A room for every kind of stay

dialogue.title: Good food, a view and conversation
dialogue.text: Just across from the hotel, on the cliffs, Dialogue Coffee & Kitchen is where you start the day with breakfast facing the sea — and where the same view keeps you company for the rest of the day.
